definitions.explanation: An instrument that measures the amount of rainfall over a given period. Built from {雨量|うりょう} (amount of rainfall) + {計|けい} (measuring device).

examples.japanese: {雨量計|うりょうけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。
examples.english: We measure the amount of rain with a rain gauge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{屋上|おくじょう}→屋上：01341_okujou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{雨量計|うりょうけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A rain gauge is installed on the roof of the school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雨量計|うりょうけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧もと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{気象庁|きしょうちょう}→気象庁：30107_kishouchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: Based on rain gauge data from various locations, the Meteorological Agency issued a heavy-rain warning.

notes:
A standard meteorological instrument. Rainfall is reported in millimeters, the depth of water that would accumulate on a flat surface.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雨量計|うりょうけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}する→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧: to install a rain gauge
- {雨量計|うりょうけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧: rain-gauge data

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{雨量|うりょう}→雨量：24555_uryou⟧: amount of rainfall — the quantity being measured
- ⟦{温度計|おんどけい}→温度計：25699_ondokei⟧: thermometer — a parallel '{...}⟦{計|けい}→計：02691_kei⟧' instrument name
